name: Citizen Solar Limited
about: Citizen Solar Limited engages in the trade of solar panels and allied products in India. The company offers Topcon and Mono Perc modules; and singe and three phase inverters. It also provides solar rooftop panel, ground mount solar system, floating solar, and solar asset management services. The company was formerly known as Citizen Infoline Limited and changed its name to Citizen Solar Limited in May 2026. Citizen Solar Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
